# Luminary Premium Hardware

Luminary creates high-end digital production hardware engineered for precision workflow control, focusing on minimalist design and high-performance materials.

- [Products](#products): Overview of our ecosystem including Horizon Display, Keyframe Core, and Acoustic Bar.

- [Connect](#connect): Newsletter and allocation sign-up for product releases and custom configurations.
